verse.verse_1: When comes the Help of Allah (to you, O Muhammad (Peace be upon him) against your enemies) and the conquest (of Makkah),
verse.verse_2: And you see that the people enter Allah's religion (Islam) in crowds,
verse.verse_3: So glorify the Praises of your Lord, and ask for His Forgiveness. Verily, He is the One Who accepts the repentance and forgives.
